title: openmmcli request file
description: Describes one openmmcli command to run via `openmmcli -f <file>.json`. The 'command' field selects the command; the remaining fields map to its arguments.

provider.description: Provider id, optionally with model: 'zhipu' or 'zhipu/cogview-3-flash'. Omit to use the default provider (config key defaults.gen.provider).

model.description: Model id (requires 'provider'). Omit to use the provider's default model for the lane.

input.description: Attachment(s) for gen.understand or text(s) to embed for gen.embed.

image.description: Reference image for gen.image (http(s)/data URL or existing path).

firstFrame.description: Video first frame / reference image for gen.video.

options.description: Provider-specific options for gen.* commands (passed as --opt k=v).

noWait.description: gen.video only: submit and print the task handle without polling.

timeout.description: Polling timeout: duration string (e.g. "5m") or milliseconds.

interval.description: Polling interval: duration string (e.g. "5s") or milliseconds.

output.description: Directory to save base64-only artifacts (gen.*) or OCI layout output directory (package.build / package.pull).

handle.description: gen.resume only: the saved task handle (object or inline JSON string).

file.description: Build manifest path (package.build) or handle file path (gen.resume).

tag.description: package.build only: image reference, e.g. org/myapp:1.0.0.

dir.description: package.build only: local directory packed as the top layer.

ref.description: package.push / package.pull only: registry reference, e.g. localhost:5000/myrepo:1.0.

plainHttp.description: Use HTTP instead of HTTPS for the registry.

key.description: config.get / config.set only: dotted config key.

value.description: config.set only: the value to store (typed JSON).
